id INT PRIMARY KEY,
name NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
team NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
score INT NOT NULL,
matches_played INT NOT NULL,
last_updated DATETIME NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE CustomLoad.employees_last7 (
id INT PRIMARY KEY,
name NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
dep NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
salary DECIMAL(10, 2) NOT NULL,
last_updated DATETIME NOT NULL
);
